draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.27, the 53rd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 10th of 34 at DE. He went 54th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Montez Sweat. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 6 sacks in 2020, 13th of 33 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Chicago Bears. 69 career games and 27 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2024. Weak spots: sacks 1.0 (22nd percentile). Played 8 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 edge rusher who played: 1.0 sacks against a median of 3.5, below the norm.
